sourceFunctions.name: createSupabaseOAuthAdapter
sourceFunctions.description: Creates the Supabase OAuth adapter around isolated start and completion operations.

sourceFunctions.name: createCompletionRunner
sourceFunctions.description: Serializes completion attempts so the same callback cannot be consumed concurrently.

sourceFunctions.name: completeOAuthReplay
sourceFunctions.description: Validates an OAuth replay against the callback fingerprint stored for its attempt.

sourceFunctions.name: parseCallback
sourceFunctions.description: Parses and validates the provider callback against the stored redirect URI.

sourceFunctions.name: invalidCallback
sourceFunctions.description: Creates a safe invalid-callback completion result.

sourceFunctions.name: completeSupabaseOAuthAuthorization
sourceFunctions.description: Completes one Supabase OAuth authorization attempt.

sourceFunctions.name: failOAuthAttempt
sourceFunctions.description: Finalizes a failed OAuth attempt, emits safe lifecycle metadata, and returns its result.

sourceFunctions.name: finalizeOAuthAttemptState
sourceFunctions.description: Marks an OAuth attempt completed and emits authentication success when applicable.

sourceFunctions.name: clearOAuthAttempt
sourceFunctions.description: Clears the active attempt and its PKCE verifier.

sourceFunctions.name: mapSupabaseOAuthError
sourceFunctions.description: Maps safe Supabase error metadata to the canonical OAuth error contract.

sourceFunctions.name: oauthStartError
sourceFunctions.description: Creates a failed OAuth start result.

sourceFunctions.name: oauthCompletionError
sourceFunctions.description: Creates a failed OAuth completion result.

sourceFunctions.name: createOAuthError
sourceFunctions.description: Creates a canonical OAuth error without exposing provider secrets.

sourceFunctions.name: exchangeAndPersistOAuthSession
sourceFunctions.description: Exchanges an OAuth code, persists its session, and verifies the generated profile.

sourceFunctions.name: emitOAuthError
sourceFunctions.description: Emits a redacted OAuth failure event for the supplied attempt.

sourceFunctions.name: emitLifecycleEvent
sourceFunctions.description: Notifies the optional lifecycle observer without changing authentication behavior.

sourceFunctions.name: resolveEnabledProvider
sourceFunctions.description: Resolves an OAuth provider against the adapter's enabled provider set.

sourceFunctions.name: normalizeRedirectUri
sourceFunctions.description: Normalizes and validates a canonical OAuth callback URI.

sourceFunctions.name: normalizeQueryParams
sourceFunctions.description: Normalizes provider query parameters while rejecting reserved OAuth fields.

sourceFunctions.name: normalizeScopes
sourceFunctions.description: Returns unique non-empty OAuth scopes in request order.

sourceFunctions.name: createPkcePair
sourceFunctions.description: Creates a PKCE verifier and its S256 challenge from an injected secure byte source.

sourceFunctions.name: createAuthorizationUrl
sourceFunctions.description: Creates the public Supabase PKCE authorization URL.

sourceFunctions.name: exchangeAuthorizationCode
sourceFunctions.description: Exchanges a Supabase PKCE authorization code through the public HTTP contract.

sourceFunctions.name: readAttempt
sourceFunctions.description: Reads and validates the persisted OAuth authorization attempt.

sourceFunctions.name: writeAttempt
sourceFunctions.description: Persists the current OAuth authorization attempt.

sourceFunctions.name: finalizeAttempt
sourceFunctions.description: Finalizes an OAuth attempt and removes its one-use PKCE verifier.

sourceFunctions.name: clearOAuthAttemptState
sourceFunctions.description: Removes all persisted state for the active OAuth attempt.

sourceFunctions.name: isAttemptExpired
sourceFunctions.description: Reports whether an OAuth attempt has reached its expiry time.

sourceFunctions.name: fingerprintOAuthCallback
sourceFunctions.description: Fingerprints one callback for exact replay detection within its attempt.

sourceFunctions.name: fingerprintConsumedOAuthCallback
sourceFunctions.description: Fingerprints one callback across attempts sharing the same redirect URI.

sourceFunctions.name: readConsumedCallbacks
sourceFunctions.description: Reads valid, unexpired callback fingerprints from persistent storage.

sourceFunctions.name: writeConsumedCallbacks
sourceFunctions.description: Persists the bounded callback replay-protection ledger.

sourceFunctions.name: constantTimeEqual
sourceFunctions.description: Compares equal-length callback fingerprints without data-dependent early exit.

sourceFunctions.name: normalizeAttemptLifetime
sourceFunctions.description: Normalizes the configured OAuth attempt lifetime.
